lines.en: It crosses several blocks in a stride.

lines.zh: 细长的腿迈得又快又稳
lines.en: Its long legs stride fast and sure.
It still carries a block of gold.
The gold catches the light under its arm.
It flickers and is somewhere else.
Purple light breaks into points around it.

lines.zh: 它走得很急，像在赶什么
lines.en: It moves urgently, as if late.
It passes the grass before the grass moves.
Its steps make no sound.
It crosses in front of your flank.
A little purple afterglow stays.
It moves faster than the eye.
It stands with the gold at its chest.

lines.zh: 它周围浮着细小的紫芒
lines.en: Fine purple sparks float around it.
Its body twitches now and then.
Its eyes glare too bright.
It shifts the gold to its other arm.

lines.zh: 它低头看金块上的反光
lines.en: It looks at the glint on the gold.
Its head snaps up, scanning.

lines.zh: 它的头转得比人快得多
lines.en: Its head turns far faster than a person's.
It angles its body slightly.
Purple light blinks at its feet.
Its breathing cannot be heard.

lines.zh: 它的手指在金块上收紧
lines.en: Its fingers tighten on the gold.

lines.zh: 它一眨眼就转过来对着你
lines.en: It is facing you between blinks.
It clutches the gold tighter.
Its eyes stay lit.
It is watching your hands.
It cocks its head at an odd angle.
It seems afraid you will take it.

lines.zh: 它的身体晃了一下，又定住
lines.en: It flickers and holds still.

lines.zh: 它后退了半步，脚没动地
lines.en: It backs half a step without moving its feet.
It makes a faint sound.
Its stare does not leave you.
It suddenly stands straight.
It is counting your movements.
A finger twitches.
It puts the gold between you.
It blinks several blocks away.

lines.zh: 紫光在它身边乱了一下
lines.en: Its purple light frays.
It looks down at the wound.
Its outline shudders.

lines.zh: 它把手里的金块抱得更紧
lines.en: It hugs the gold tighter.
It makes a low sound.
It relocates twice in a row.
It stops, breathing faster.
Its stare jumps twice.
It stops retreating and leans in.
It fixes on what you hold.
It reaches out and pulls back.

lines.zh: 它一手抱着金块，一手接住
lines.en: Gold under one arm, it takes with the other.

lines.zh: 它低头看，判断值不值钱
lines.en: It looks down, judging its worth.
It stows the item quickly.
It wants a second.

lines.zh: 它对你手里的金属更感兴趣
lines.en: Metal interests it more than food.

lines.zh: 它把金块抱得更警惕了
lines.en: It hugs the gold more warily.
It withdraws, as if you might take it back.
It vanishes and reappears.
It strikes you and blinks away.

lines.zh: 它在两格之外重新出现
lines.en: It reappears two blocks off.
Burdened by the gold, it falters.
The gold nearly slips.
It takes both hands to steady it.
It slips past behind you.
Its arm brushes your shoulder.
Purple light bursts at the impact.
It withdraws a few paces.
It checks the gold is still there.
Two figures appear at once.

lines.zh: 它们交换了一次短促的响
lines.en: They trade one short sound.
They set their gold side by side.
Their purple light mingles.
Their movements match exactly.

lines.zh: 一个闪走，另一个立刻跟上
lines.en: One blinks away; the other follows instantly.
They reappear in the distance.
They stand one to each side.
Nothing passes between them.
Then they part again.
It reaches and takes it.
It holds it to its eyes.
It tucks the item under its arm.
It shifts how it holds the gold.
Two looks and it discards it.
It keeps anything useful.

lines.zh: 它拾取的动作快得看不清
lines.en: Its pick-up is too fast to follow.
It presses the item to its chest.

lines.zh: 它退开的同时东西已收好
lines.en: It stows the thing as it retreats.
It returns to its old spot.
Its eyes flare brighter.

lines.zh: 它把金块夹紧，空出一只手
lines.en: It clamps the gold and frees a hand.
Purple light gathers behind it.
It is suddenly in front of you.
Its arm comes up.

lines.zh: 它周围的空气开始抖动
lines.en: The air around it starts to shiver.
It blinks position three times.
Each stop is closer.
Its head cants to one side.
Its palm opens.
Purple threads run between its fingers.
It has already worked out where to land.
It blinks around you in a ring.

lines.zh: 每次都出现在你的盲侧
lines.en: Always on your blind side.
It tries to touch your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你转身，它已经不在那了
lines.en: You turn; it is not there.

lines.zh: 紫光在你背后亮了一下
lines.en: Purple light blooms behind you.

lines.zh: 它的移动快得只剩残影
lines.en: All that is left is afterimage.
It lets you see it once, deliberately.
That one is to make you turn.

lines.zh: 它在你周围形成一个圈
lines.en: It forms a ring around you.

lines.zh: 它的呼吸声在你耳边响
lines.en: Its breathing sounds at your ear.
The gold's weight slows it.
It lowers the gold a little.

lines.zh: 它在找最好的出手时机
lines.en: It is hunting the best moment.
Its palm slams your chest.
A hand whips in from the side.

lines.zh: 它抓住你的衣领往上提
lines.en: It grips your collar and lifts.
A foot hooks behind your knee.
It strikes and blinks two blocks off.

lines.zh: 它连续三次从不同方向打
lines.en: Three blows from three directions.

lines.zh: 它的指节刮过你的护甲
lines.en: Its knuckles scrape your armour.

lines.zh: 它把金块当作武器砸来
lines.en: It swings the gold like a weapon.

lines.zh: 它的动作快得没有预兆
lines.en: Its strikes come with no warning.
The miss becomes an instant reposition.
A palm presses down on your shoulder.
It retreats and is instantly back.
Purple points light in the air.
It appears from nothing, blocks away.
The gold arrives first, on the ground.
Then it takes shape.

lines.zh: 它的身形抖了两下才定住
lines.en: Its outline shakes twice and holds.
The purple light draws into it.
It bends and picks the gold up.
It straightens, far taller than you.
Two points light in its eyes.
Its head turns your way inch by inch.
It does not come at once.
It simply stands and watches.
It tucks the gold under its arm.

lines.zh: 它一闪躲开，衣角还是焦了
lines.en: It blinks clear, but a corner still scorches.
It stumbles on landing.

lines.zh: 水里它闪不动，拼命挣扎
lines.en: In water it cannot blink and thrashes.
The blast breaks its blink.

lines.zh: 箭扎进肩头，它一把拔掉
lines.en: An arrow sticks in its shoulder; it yanks it out.
Odd force tangles it; the purple scatters.

lines.zh: 饿久了，它闪得没以前远
lines.en: Starved, it no longer blinks as far.

lines.zh: 雷击让它僵住，紫光炸开
lines.en: Lightning locks it and the purple bursts.

lines.zh: 虚空吸它，它拼命闪回来
lines.en: The void pulls; it blinks hard to get back.
